entries.en: Despite the upcoming match against Siegfried looming over him, Martyn seems to be in high spirits. Having avoided any major catastrophes, it appears that there is no need for you to act as his replacement after all, and your mentor claims to be in top form. Since there is still time remaining before he is due to appear in the arena, he takes the opportunity to attend to some outstanding matters, leaving you to wait for him at the Blue Mages' Guild. When Royse arrives to check up on Martyn, she is livid but not entirely surprised that he should suddenly disappear so close to the battle, though as Latool Ja points out, he may have gone to gather information on his opponent. Since Siegfried is a renowned gladiator at the Coliseum, it stands to reason that Martyn would have headed there to make his inquiries.
entries.fr: Prétextant des affaires à régler, Martyn s'est éclipsé au grand dam de Royse, affolée de découvrir son champion aux abonnés absents à quelques heures de son grand duel. D'après Latool Ja, votre ami aurait récemment pris conscience de l'importance d'une bonne préparation, et se serait donc rendu au Colisée pour se renseigner sur son adversaire. Toutefois, l'heure tourne, et Royse vous a donc  à vous rendre sur place afin de le retrouver au plus vite. Interrogez les badauds et les gladiateurs du Colisée.
entries.ja: マーティンと話したところ、ジークフリードとの試合を前にして、野暮用があると去っていった。ロイスがやって来て、ジークフリードの「下調べ」にいったと判明した、マーティンを探すことになった。ウルダハのコロセウムでマーティンらしき男の目撃情報を集めよう。

entries.en: After quizzing some of the spectators and combatants at the Coliseum, you and Royse discover that Martyn had in fact made his way here. Though much of what you hear is largely irrelevant, you are able to glean some semblance of useful information. It would appear that he was hoping to uncover whether Siegfried possesses any weaknesses he may be able to exploit, which is an uncharacteristically methodical approach for someone known for never being adequately prepared for anything.
entries.fr: Vous avez eu une triple confirmation que Martyn s'était bien rendu au Colisée. Toutefois, celui-ci demeure introuvable... Retournez auprès de Royse.

entries.en:
You return to Royse to share your findings, and it is not long before Martyn himself finally shows up, claiming that he was merely seeking to gain the upper hand in the bout with Siegfried. Satisfied that he has discovered a strategy by which he may vanquish the formidable gladiator, he leads the way to the Celestium.

The crowd erupts as Martyn steps into the arena dressed as the Great Azuro, while Siegfried emerges equipped in a suit of Garlean magitek, with an impossibly large greatsword in one hand and an enormous firearm in the other. Martyn displays his unique brand of unfounded optimism despite having no idea of Siegfried's true capabilities, and opens the match with an impressive array of blue magic spells. His hulking opponent is unable to withstand the assault, and it appears that the Great Azuro has secured a flawless victory.

However, before the winner can be announced, Martyn comes to the realization that Siegfried is standing right behind him, while the fallen foe on the other side of the arena vanishes in a puff of smoke. The tables having been turned in a heartbeat, Siegfried blasts Martyn at point-blank range with his firearm, only for the blue mage to repel the attack with Mighty Guard. A barrage of cannon fire rains down on the barrier until Martyn can maintain it no longer, and he crumples to the sand. The gladiator draws closer and aims his firearm at his hapless foe, offering an opportunity to surrender, but Martyn seizes the opening and makes a last-ditch attack with Self-destruct.

Every spectator in the Celestium is struck silent, and when the smoke finally clears, Martyn is lying motionless, while Siegfried remains on his feet, seemingly none the worse for wear. He admits that he was only saved by his armor and appeals to Fyrgeiss to allow a rematch. Since his original opponent is unlikely to be fit to appear in the arena any time soon─and may even be dead, as nobody has bothered to check whether he is still breathing─you are chosen as his replacement to defend the reputation of the Blue Mages' Guild and to keep the Celestium under Royse's ownership.

entries.en:
Now that the dust has settled, it seems that Martyn has escaped relatively unscathed, though the fate of the Celestium now rests on your shoulders. Doubt has been cast on Martyn's claims that blue mages can adapt to any situation, and he feels it necessary to discard the research materials he has compiled and start afresh. He asks that you lead a party comprised entirely of blue mages and test the effectiveness of various strategies, which may also serve as means to prepare for the confrontation with Siegfried.

※The next blue mage quest will be available from Martyn after completing stage 30 of the Masked Carnivale.

Le Bleuet masqué premier du nom a perdu son duel, mais le pari avec Fyrgeiss tient miraculeusement toujours, ses enjeux désormais reportés sur votre rencontre prochaine avec “le plus grand bretteur du monde”. Royse a mis sur pied de nouvelles joutes bestiales auxquelles vous pourrez participer en préparation de l'affrontement. De son côté, Martyn a fait vœu d'humilité, estimant qu'il avait péché par orgueil. Bien décidé à prouver sa théorie envers et contre tout, il vous a chargé d'explorer un maximum de lieux en compagnie d'autres mages bleus... sans oublier au passage de vaincre Siegfried afin de laver l'honneur des Bleuets masqués !
* Martyn propose la prochaine quête aux mages bleus ayant réussi le niveau 30 de la Grande Mascarade.

entries.en: A ridiculous circus, is what that dreadful Masked Carnivale is─a mockery of honorable combat! Why, were my beloved Franz ever to make an appearance there, I...might be persuaded to temporarily lower my standards and visit the Celestium...
entries.fr: Entre nous, cette Grande Mascarade est d'un vulgaire... Je n'en reviens pas qu'un noble gladiateur comme Siegfried accepte d'y participer. D'un autre côté, ça me ferait plaisir qu'il ratatine son adversaire !
entries.ja:
マスクカーニバルなんて下品な見世物、
大富豪令嬢の私が見るものではないわ。
まあ、フランツ様が出場するなら考えてもいいけど……。

マスクカーニバルを懸けた、大事な決戦なんだからね……！

entries.en: All right, love, keep your hair on! I'm only askin' about my opponent, is all. I'm in the middle of “failing to prepare”! No wait, that's not right...
entries.fr: Vous vous inquiétiez pour moi ? Il fallait pas... J'étais simplement venu mener ma petite enquête sur Siegfried afin de maximiser mes chances de victoire. Ne dit-on pas qu'une bonne préparation est la clef du succès ?

それならご安心ください！
コロセウムや剣術士ギルドで聞き込みをして、
ジークフリードの「下調べ」はバッチリですよ……！

entries.en: Anyway, it's as I thought. That ploddin' goobbue only knows how to attack from close quarters, so all I have to do is bombard him with my best spells before he has a chance to get near me! What could possibly go wrong?
entries.fr: Comme je le pensais, ce gros plein de muscles n'est bon qu'en combat rapproché. Je n'ai qu'à le bombarder à distance avec mes sorts les plus puissants et hop, adieu gorille !
entries.ja:
やはり、ヤツは力任せの近接攻撃しかできないキンニクだるま！
開始から怒涛の如く強力な青魔法を食らわせれば、
なす術もなくイチコロでしょう！

entries.fr: Mesdames et Messieurs, aujourd'hui est un grand jour ! Deux hommes que tout oppose vont s'affronter sous vos yeux, pour votre plus grand plaisir... Ça va être historique !!!

さぁさぁ、お集まりの紳士淑女の皆さん！
お待ちかねの夢の対決、西紀の一戦の開幕だ！

entries.en: Master of knowledge beyond the comprehension of mere mortals, and wielder of arcane magicks as unfathomable as the deepest ocean... The indomitable keeper of the blue has come!
entries.fr: Avec à ma droite quelqu'un que vous connaissez bien. Lorsque sonne l'heure bleue, il surgit, prêt à punir le crime et à ravir les cœurs...
entries.ja:
まずはご存じ、蒼天の空より鮮やかで、紺碧の海よりも深い……
闘技場をそんな群青に染める仮面の紳士！

entries.en: Introducing his opponent, stepping straight from the pages of myth, the peerless swordsman and champion of the Coliseum...
entries.fr: À ma gauche, un héros tout droit échappé d'un classique de la littérature, un gladiateur de génie qui a d'ores et déjà conquis le public du Colisée...
entries.ja:
対する挑戦者はぁ……
コロセウムのスターにして、
かの古典小説から現れた世界一の剣士！

entries.en: I can't believe my eyes, ladies and gentlemen! I've never seen such a drastic transformation!

お～っとぉ～～～！
これはいったい……！？
ジークフリードの出で立ちが、いつもと違うようだぁーーー！！

entries.en: As we all know, the Great Azuro is fond of his little tricks, so Siegfried decided to prepare a few of his own.
entries.fr: C'est juste un petit accessoire dont je l'ai équipé pour qu'il puisse contrer les tours de passe-passe du mage bleu... Ce n'est pas interdit par le règlement, à ce que je sache.
entries.ja:
青魔道士の小賢しい術に対抗するため、
こちらも帝国製の武器で、少しばかり武装させてもらった。

魔導兵器の残骸を回収していたりもするのでね……。

なにが少しばかりよ！
もはや、世界一の剣士とされる、
小説のジークフリードの原型もないじゃないッ！？

entries.fr: Haha, rassurez-vous. Le Bleuet masqué n'a rien à craindre d'une vulgaire arme à feu.
entries.ja:
フ、フン……
土壇場の付け焼刃など問題なしッ！

ジークフリードの予想外の攻撃も驚きだが、

おのれ、帝国製の武器のうえに、分身までするとは……。

ジークフリードの猛攻になす術もなく、ダウンかと思われたが、

さすがですね。
この武器に耐えられるなんて、並大抵じゃありませんよ。
でも……終わりにしましょう。

entries.fr: Le Bleuet masqué meurt, mais ne se rend pas !!!
entries.ja: 青魔道士の切り札を喰らうがいいッ……！！

entries.ja:
なんとぉ～～～！
マーティンの捨て身の技にも、ジークフリードは倒れないッ！
挑戦者の勝利だぁ～～～～～～！

なんという技だ……。
いまのは、この装甲がなければ、やられていた。
恐るべし……青魔道士。

entries.en: Father, for the sake of my honor, I demand a rematch!
entries.fr: J'ai gagné grâce aux atouts dont m'a doté mon père. Ce n'était pas un combat équitable. Aussi, j'aimerais offrir sa revanche au Bleuet masqué.
